key.name: left-click-toggles
key.summary: Left click starts and stops dictation
key.description: When false, left click opens the menu like right click does.

key.name: show-when-stopped
key.summary: Keep the panel icon visible while the voxtype service is stopped

key.name: pill-style
key.summary: Look of the on-screen recording indicator

key.name: show-waveform
key.summary: Draw a live waveform inside the recording indicator

key.name: accent-color
key.summary: Accent color of the indicators, as #rrggbb
key.description: Used for the recording indicator's waveform and Classic border, and the panel icon while dictating or transcribing.

key.name: use-gpu
key.summary: Use the GPU for models that can
key.description: Remembered while a model that cannot use the GPU is selected, so going back restores it.

key.name: cleanup-command
key.description: Kept here so that turning text cleanup off, which removes it from the voxtype config, does not lose it.

key.name: cleanup-anything-enabled
key.summary: Clean up the focused text field on a trigger

key.name: cleanup-anything-max-chars
key.summary: Longest text the Cleanup Hotkey will send
key.description: Also guards against Ctrl+A selecting a whole page or document.

key.name: pill-x
key.summary: Horizontal indicator position, as a fraction of the free space on the primary monitor

key.name: pill-y
key.summary: Vertical indicator position, as a fraction of the free space on the primary monitor
